main_text.l: mortalem, omnia illa incommoda, in quæ à
& membra nostra mortificemus in carne: à
studiis carnis, quàm diligentissimè fieri potest,
abscedamus: Deum quæramus in Ecclesia: Ec-
clesiam in Deo, nos & fratres nostros in Deo &
omnibus à Deo constitutam colamus constan-
Deo, in Ecclesia, in nobis, & inter nos religio-
tum Domini & Seruatoris nostri Iesu Christi:
qui pacè hîc in se partam, & in nobis inchoa-
tam, illîc in cælis consummaturus est perfecta

page.notes: The first word of the page continues a sentence from the previous page. The tilde over "carnê" and "pacè" and the circumflex over "hîc" and "illîc" are printed as shown but are faint on the scan. The catchword "PARS" and the signature "P 4" are read from the foot of the page. The spelling is kept as printed, including the long s in the Latin, which is written as plain s.
